name: Xodus
tagline: JetBrains' embedded transactional Java/Kotlin store behind YouTrack; in sunset in favour of YouTrackDB.
description: Xodus is a schema-less embedded database written in Java and Kotlin by JetBrains for YouTrack and JetBrains Hub. It offers three layers: Environments, a transactional key-value store over an append-only log; Entity Stores, with entities that carry properties, blobs and links and a query API; and a virtual file system. Transactions are fully ACID with MVCC snapshot isolation, so reads never block, and there is no server to install. It is Apache 2.0 licensed. The last release, 2.0.1, came out in March 2022, and in 2025 JetBrains marked the project as entering its sunset stage as it moves to YouTrackDB, its OrientDB-derived graph database.
statusNote: JetBrains put Xodus into its 'sunset' stage in Sept 2025 while migrating to YouTrackDB; last release 2.0.1 (March 2022).

scale.notes: Single-process embedded store; YouTrack runs large instances on it.

strengths: Fully ACID with MVCC snapshot isolation; readers never block writers
Embedded and pure JVM: no native libraries or server process
Battle-tested as the storage engine of YouTrack
Entity Store layer adds links and queries on top of key-value storage
weaknesses: Sunset stage: no new features and migration expected
JVM-only, with a modest community outside JetBrains
useCases: Embedded storage for JVM desktop or server apps
